messages.subject: excellent course on Bayesian modeling in Ecology
parts:
Dear all,

I recently became aware of a really great course on Bayesian modeling in ecology, using JAGS for the most part, by Tom Hobbs, Mary Collins and Chris Che-Castaldo and strongly based on the books by Hobbs & Hooten and McElreath. Please see here for a course website that is continually being updated:

https://cchecastaldo.github.io/BayesianShortCourse/Syllabus.html

Best regards --- Marc
